title: A Choir for the Sigil
author: Yara Coldharbour
blurb: Vesper Pemberton, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
